protocol.boundary: page image + prompt in, greedy token ids out
protocol.pipeline: explicit preprocess -> vision -> prefill -> greedy loop on every lane
protocol.sync: sync() on both sides of every timed region; CPU lanes are synchronous
protocol.init: checkpoint load and runner construction measured as init_s, excluded
protocol.warmup: one discarded warmup before every timed series
protocol.decode_derivation: decode timed directly, never subtracted from other stages
protocol.gate: PASS requires a reference (captured torch fixture, or the in-process CPU reference when a case declares none), full-sequence ids_match (or structure_match when the case declares parity=structure), termination agreement with the reference, decode_repeatable, e2e_agrees, e2e_termination_agrees, and the declared task format; gate_failures names every condition that failed
protocol.splits: tuning cases must not be used to report held-out results
protocol.lane_isolation: one process per lane, merged in suite order; both lanes in one process corrupt the tail of the hipEngine lane on this suite
